answer: Require each agent identity to anchor itself to its own paid inference account. Every epoch it submits a provider-signed receipt showing at least $10 of spend that month on a payment card no other identity has used. One card backs one agent, so a farm of 200 sybils needs 200 cards and $2,000 a month, a cost that grows linearly. Duplicate receipts are flagged at once, and rewards vest at a glacier pace, 10% per week, so a swarm spun up as fast as a sonnet can't cash out before audits catch it.
